lst.dataset: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API (ERA5 reanalysis) temperature_2m_max
lst.note: ERA5 2 m air temperature, not LST; sampled at 0.1° resolution

dem.note: slope = central difference over ±0.01° around cell centre

s5p.dataset: Open-Meteo Air Quality API (CAMS global atmospheric composition forecasts)
s5p.note: CAMS model output, not Sentinel-5P; sampled at 0.1° resolution; aod used instead of aai
